method: PLS regression (pls::plsr, kernel PLS), X and y mean-centred, no scaling, no preprocessing
source: Mevik B-H, Wehrens R (2007) The pls package: principal component and partial least squares regression in R. J Stat Softw 18(2):1-23, doi:10.18637/jss.v018.i02, section 2 (summary(gas1), explvar(gas1), predict(gas1, ncomp = 2, newdata = gasTest), RMSEP(gas1, newdata = gasTest))

protocol.n_components: 0 (intercept only) to 10; list index = number of components

tolerance.note: Published values have 4 significant digits (relative rounding <= 3.3e-4), predictions 2 decimals.

notes: rmsep_test[0] (1.5114) is the population standard deviation of the 10 test octane values: pls computes the intercept-only test RMSEP with the test-set mean. Predicting the training mean gives 1.5369. Compare components 1-10 only, or reproduce this convention explicitly.
x_variance_explained_cumulative_pct and y_variance_explained_cumulative_pct are printed by summary(gas1) (the y row is on the same page); x_variance_explained_per_component_pct by explvar(gas1).
